meta.title: Manage Line Items: Save fails when price field is left empty

plan.title: Draft line-item save with blank price

steps.note: Start an eRFX create flow so a saved draft can be prepared.
Apply a pricing template before adding line items.
Create the single line item that will be edited in Manage Line Items.
Complete the initial pricing sheet so the draft can be saved.
Create the saved, unpublished eRFX draft required by the scenario.
Navigate to the events list to locate the saved draft.

args.goal: On the draft create screen, open the Items 1 Manage Line Items window, select a product, set Quantity to 90, leave the Price field blank, click Save, and stop when the app shows the resulting save refusal or validation message.

steps.note: Perform the specific drawer interaction that no dedicated catalog step can express.
Assert that saving with the blank price was refused.
